hjaldar_10.m: I guess, if you can find him, he might be able to provide you with some Lyson marrow extract.
r: Any ideas on where I might find him?
This sounds like too much trouble. Never mind that potion.

hjaldar_11.m: OK then. Sorry I couldn't help you. Goodbye.

hjaldar_12.m: No, I don't know. Last time I saw him, he was headed west. From the looks of his backpack, it looked like he was getting ready for quite a long trip to the west.

hjaldar_13.m: He even had gear for travelling through colder climates - snow and ice and that sort of thing.
r: Thanks for the info. I will try to find him.
This sounds like too much trouble. Never mind that potion.

hjaldar_14.m: Good luck finding him. If you do find him, which I doubt you do, please say hello to him from me, and tell him that I am well.

hjaldar_2.m: I used to be a potion-maker. In fact, I used to be the only potion-maker here in Remgard.

hjaldar_3.m: That was good business. People even travelled here from other cities down the mountain.

hjaldar_4.m: Well, two things. Firstly, I am getting older and don't have the desire to be working full days, making potions for gold.

hjaldar_5.m: Secondly, I ran out of most of the ingredients. Some of them are really hard to get.
r: Too bad. Nice talking to you, goodbye.
I am looking for a potion of accuracy focus for the Elwille sisters, can you help with that?

hjaldar_6.m: Oh, potions of accuracy focus. Yes, those were popular. Unfortunately, I can't help you with that now.

hjaldar_7.m: My supply of Lyson marrow extract has gone dry. Without some of that, I can't make potions that are useful for anything really.
r: Is there somewhere I can get some, and bring it to you?

hjaldar_7r.m: Hello again. Sorry about not being able to help you with those potions of accuracy focus that you asked for.

hjaldar_8.m: I doubt that. It is really hard to find. Only the most well-stocked potion-makers have it.

hjaldar_9.m: I used to get my supply from my old friend Mazeg. I have no idea where he might be these days though.

hjaldar_pots_1.m: Thanks for contacting Mazeg for me earlier. With this Lyson marrow extract that you brought me, I can now make other potions for you if you want.
r: Let me see what potions you have.

hjaldar_r1.m: Hello again. Did you find my old friend Mazeg?
r: Yes, I brought you some Lyson marrow extract.
What was that you were saying about those potions of accuracy focus?
What made you stop making potions?
Any ideas on where I might find Mazeg?

hjaldar_r10.m: Add some of this into some clean vials...

hjaldar_r11.m: Just a pinch of these into one of these vials...

hjaldar_r13.m: There. Now we just need to give them a good shake.

hjaldar_r14.m: [Hjaldar shakes the vials vigorously, one in each of his hands]

hjaldar_r15.m: Ah, that should do it. Here you go. One potion of accuracy focus and one potion of damage focus. I hope they will be useful to you.
r: Whatever. I sure hope all this work is worth it!

hjaldar_r2.m: Oh wow. Yes, this is indeed some of that marrow extract. Nice work finding it!

hjaldar_r3.m: Thanks for bringing me some of that marrow extract. Nice work finding it!

hjaldar_r4.m: Tell me, did you find Mazeg or did you get it from somewhere else?
r: I visited Mazeg up in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
You made me run all the way to Blackwater mountain, I sure hope those potions are worth it!

hjaldar_r5.m: Blackwater mountain? I'm afraid I don't know where that is. Never mind, I hope that all is well with my old friend.
r: He told me to send you his warmest greetings.
He seemed like a pitiful old man that has seen the best of his days.

hjaldar_r6.m: Good. Good. I am glad to hear he is well.

hjaldar_r7.m: Time has not been on his side, I see.

hjaldar_r8.m: Anyway. Let's make that potion that you asked for earlier. I even prepared the other ingredients for another potion beforehand.

hjaldar_r9.m:
Now, let's see. Some of these...
[Hjaldar pulls out some dried up berries and puts them in his mortar]

sisterfight.10: I heard a story about two squabbling sisters in Remgard, Elwel and Elwyl. Apparently they have kept people awake at night with the way they are shouting at each other. I should go visit them in their house on the southern shore of the city of Remgard.
sisterfight.20: I have talked to Elwyl, one of the Elwille sisters in Remgard. She is furious at her sister for not agreeing on even the most simple of facts. Apparently, they have had their disagreements with each other for several years.
sisterfight.21: Elwel will not speak to me.
sisterfight.30: One matter that the sisters disagree on currently is the color of a certain potion that the town potion-maker Hjaldar used to make. Elwyl says that the potion of accuracy focus that Hjaldar used to make was a blue potion, but Elwel insists that the potion was a green substance.
sisterfight.31: Elwyl wants me to get a potion of accuracy focus from Hjaldar here in Remgard so that she can finally prove to Elwel that she is wrong.
sisterfight.40: I have talked to Hjaldar in Remgard. Hjaldar no longer makes potions since his supply of Lyson marrow extract has gone dry.
sisterfight.41: Apparently, Hjaldar's old friend Mazeg would surely have some Lyson marrow extract to sell. Unfortunately, he does not know where Mazeg currently lives. He only knows that Mazeg traveled far to the west last time they met.
sisterfight.45: I should find Mazeg and get some Lyson marrow extract so that Hjaldar can start making potions again.
sisterfight.50: I have talked to Mazeg in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Since I helped the people of the Blackwater mountain before, he is willing to sell me a vial of Lyson marrow extract for only 400 gold.
sisterfight.51: I have talked to Mazeg in the Blackwater mountain settlement. He is willing to sell me Lyson marrow extract for 800 gold.
sisterfight.55: I have bought some Lyson marrow extract from Mazeg. I should return to Remgard and give it to Hjaldar.
sisterfight.60: Hjaldar thanked me for bringing him the marrow extract.
sisterfight.61: Hjaldar can now create potions again, and is willing to trade with me. He even gave me some of the first potions that he made. I should go visit the Elwille sisters here in Remgard again, and show them a potion of accuracy focus.
sisterfight.70: I have given a potion of accuracy focus to Elwyl.
sisterfight.71: Unfortunately, it did not cause their squabbling to diminish. On the contrary, they seem to be even more angry at each other now, since both of them had the color wrong.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
